method: Actual native image tool inspection of all three PNGs and a first/middle/last GIF contact sheet; no browser opened for review.
findings: 390x900 actual Taro viewport, no horizontal clipping observed in checked regions.
Checklist shows an actual open task and restricted conditions remain distinct from zero.
Retrospective screenshot covers the three filled notes; lower attestations are outside this viewport.
History screenshot covers actual archive version, current-name attribution and fixed notes.
GIF samples show the actual form, archived history and preserved changed-basis history after reopening.
Credentials are excluded by capture preconditions; sampled pixels show no password, MFA code or token.
limits: Automation is fast: 3.6-second silent MP4 and 22-frame GIF; inspected samples are not an exhaustive review of every encoded pixel, device acceptance or cloud/model/TG execution.
